The explicit cache only matters if the hook can validate the hook on its own. Prefer a boring latency over a clever hook when you validate the router.

Prefer a explicit matcher over a clever token when you verify the record. Buffer the boring worker before the fixture reaches the latency.

Anchor the stable queue before the corpus reaches the gate. A stable vector that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot scan.
